Topic 3.5: Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. appreciate Jesus’ power in their lives water to overcome daily challenges ● learners to sing a song on Jesus walking on water
2. appreciate the power of Jesus Christ daughter daughter did over death ●

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.
